title: Remove All Occurrences of a Substring
summary: Starting with two strings, s and part, repeatedly identify and remove the leftmost occurrence of part from s until part is no longer a substring of s.
statement: Starting with two strings, s and part, repeatedly identify and remove the leftmost occurrence of part from s until part is no longer a substring of s. Return the modified s after all occurrences of part have been removed.
constraints: s and part are nonempty lowercase strings of length at most 1000.
Repeatedly remove the current leftmost occurrence of part.
Continue until no occurrence remains, including occurrences newly formed by earlier removals.
hints: Characters before the current scan point are final except for a suffix that may complete part.
Push each character, and whenever the stack suffix equals part, delete that suffix immediately.
Join the remaining stack after the scan.
Immediate suffix deletion reproduces the next leftmost available removal; induction over consumed input characters proves equivalence to the repeated process.
editorial: Immediate suffix deletion reproduces the next leftmost available removal; induction over consumed input characters proves equivalence to the repeated process.
